South Surrey acreages for sale: houses and land on lots of one acre or more. The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board benchmark for a detached house in South Surrey was $1,612,500 in September 2026. Jared sets up a search for the size, area and use you want, and checks whether the land is in the ALR before you offer.

Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: South Surrey: the detached houses benchmark was $1,612,500 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 7.4%; over three months it fell 4.9%; over the last month it fell 2.2%. Longer term, over 3 years it fell 17.9%; over 5 years it fell 5.3%.

Median is the middle sale price of the month and average is the total of sale prices divided by sales; both swing when few homes sell, so a month with fewer than 3 sales is not read as a trend.

blocks.text: In September 2026 South Surrey had 60 detached houses sales and 600 active listings (48 sales and 616 active in August; 41 and 664 in September 2025). Sales rose 46.3% against September 2025. Active listings fell 9.6% against September 2025.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

items.t: South Surrey real estate market stats

faq.q: Is South Surrey a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in South Surrey had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in South Surrey?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in South Surrey that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when acreages come up in South Surrey?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all South Surrey homes?
faq.a: The South Surrey homes for sale page covers every home type, and the South Surrey market stats page has the monthly figures.
